aboutParagraphs: Our lab specializes in multiscale simulations that bridge atomic, microscopic, and macroscopic scales to understand material behavior, fluid dynamics, and structural mechanics.
We collaborate with industry and academia to develop innovative computational tools and apply them to real-world challenges.
